{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: Releases

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - '*'
  # Manually triggered workflow
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target_repo:
        description: 'The repository to publish the package'
        required: true
        default: 'pypi.org'
        type: choice
        options:
        - pypi.org
        - test.pypi.org

env:
  UV_VERSION: 0.13.7

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      # inputs.target_repo is set only when workflow was manually triggered. Default to 'pypi.org' for tags push
      pypi_target: ${{ github.event.inputs.target_repo || 'pypi.org' }}

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: Install uv
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3, see https://github.com/astral-sh/setup-uv/releases
      with:
        version: ${{ env.UV_VERSION }}

    - name: Cache uv dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/uv
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock', 'pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-uv-

    - name: Build
      run: uv build

    - name: Publish on Pypi
      if: env.pypi_target == 'pypi.org'
      run: uv publish --token ${{ secrets.PYPI_AUTH_TOKEN }}

    - name: Publish on TestPypi
      if: env.pypi_target == 'test.pypi.org'
      run: uv publish --index testpypi --token ${{ secrets.PYPI_AUTH_TOKEN_TEST }}", "rationale": "Applied P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads): added an actions/cache step for the uv dependency cache (~/.cache/uv), keyed on uv.lock and pyproject.toml with a restore-key fallback. This preserves the existing checkout, build, and publish steps unchanged, adds no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions, and does not weaken permissions. The repository has uv.lock and pyproject.toml, satisfying the cache-input precondition, and no equivalent persisted cache exists in the workflow.", "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]}
